description: Windah's first car-chase mission in GTA VI (his own launch stream 45r3OyaxvFE, 18 Nov 2026). Source = stream-2100-2200.mp4 file 27:30-34:00 (source.mp4 local t = file t - 1650 s; local 0 = WIB 21:27:30; 390 s). New clean layout (19 Nov 2026): solid Ink #0E0F12, the whole 16:9 gameplay frame uncropped scaled to 1080x608 at y=656 (his facecam stays inside the game frame, bottom-right), no blur, no separate face panel. Hook = a short written title, not a quote, on screen from 0.00 s for the whole main clip: Audex 92, 2 lines max, bottom-anchored at (540,600), line 1 Paper 'MISI KEJAR-KEJARAN', line 2 Volt 'PERTAMA WINDAH'. Word captions Audex 72 Volt (Paper emphasis), Ink outline 7, shadow 3, one line, centred at (540,960). Credit line Audex 30 Mist at (540,1290) 'WINDAH BASUDARA · GTA VI' for the whole main clip. Watermark overlays the main clip only, then the 4 s outro, loudnorm two-pass -14 LUFS / -1 dBTP. Story in order: he is chased by police earlier in the stream; here he chases Arnold (a mafia boss's man), not police. Cuts: A local 113.30-119.25 (WIB 21:29:23-21:29:29) -> output 0.00-5.95; D local 133.95-138.20 (WIB 21:29:43-21:29:48) -> output 5.95-10.20; D2 local 143.45-146.25 (WIB 21:29:53-21:29:56) -> output 10.20-13.00; E local 151.85-154.30 (WIB 21:30:01-21:30:04) -> output 13.00-15.45; F local 195.50-197.60 (WIB 21:30:45-21:30:47) -> output 15.45-17.55; G1 local 203.25-206.00 (WIB 21:30:53-21:30:56) -> output 17.55-20.30; G2 local 209.80-213.00 (WIB 21:30:59-21:31:03) -> output 20.30-23.50; G3 local 216.60-219.20 (WIB 21:31:06-21:31:09) -> output 23.50-26.10; H local 236.20-243.30 (WIB 21:31:26-21:31:33) -> output 26.10-33.20; I1 local 252.45-255.20 (WIB 21:31:42-21:31:45) -> output 33.20-35.95; I2 local 256.90-261.35 (WIB 21:31:46-21:31:51) -> output 35.95-40.40. Main 40.40 s + 4.0 s outro. Original audio kept (no mutes, user decision). Sensitive moments (kept unedited): D 134-138 and D2 143.5-146 talk about shooting back (L1) with the gun HUD visible; H 'gua yang aim' mentions aiming; the in-game subtitle line at F may show 'fucking' text (see stills). 'ngem' in the YouTube auto-caption is read as 'aim'. Source is input-seeked (-ss 100 -t 170), so trim times in filter_complex = local t - 100.
